items.source: NOTE: This variant will only be invoked in case of Jakarta EE style container bootstrapping where a PersistenceUnitInfo is present (i.e. LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean). In case of simple Java SE style bootstrapping via Persistence (i.e. LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean), the parameter-less getJpaPropertyMap() variant will be called directly.
items.translation: 注意：此变体仅在 Jakarta EE 风格的容器引导过程中被调用，此时存在一个 PersistenceUnitInfo（即 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean）。在通过 Persistence 进行简单 Java SE 风格引导的情况下（即 LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean），将直接调用无参数的 getJpaPropertyMap() 变体。

items.source: This implementation delegates to getJpaPropertyMap() for non-unit-dependent properties. Effectively, this PersistenceUnitInfo-based variant only needs to be implemented if there is an actual need to react to unit-specific characteristics such as the transaction type.
items.translation: 此实现将非单元依赖属性的处理委托给 getJpaPropertyMap()。实际上，只有当确实需要响应单元特定特性（如事务类型）时，才需要实现这种基于 PersistenceUnitInfo 的变体。

items.source: If the provider does not offer any EntityManagerFactory extensions, the adapter should simply return the standard EntityManagerFactory class here.
items.translation: 如果提供者不提供任何 EntityManagerFactory 扩展，适配器应在此处简单地返回标准的 `EntityManagerFactory` 类。

items.source: If the provider does not offer any EntityManager extensions, the adapter should simply return the standard EntityManager class here.
items.translation: 如果提供者不提供任何 EntityManager 扩展，适配器应在此处简单地返回标准的`EntityManager`类。

items.source:
Note that there might be further JPA properties defined on the
EntityManagerFactory bean, which might potentially override individual
JPA property values specified here.
items.translation: 请注意，可能在 EntityManagerFactory 豆子上定义了进一步的 JPA 属性，这些属性可能会覆盖此处指定的各个 JPA 属性值。

items.source:
This can be used for triggering vendor-specific initialization processes.
While this is not expected to be used for most providers, it is included
here as a general extension hook.
items.translation: 这可用于触发供应商特定的初始化过程。虽然大多数提供者不会使用此功能，但此处将其包含作为通用扩展钩子。

items.source:
This can be used for setting vendor-specific parameters, for example,
Hibernate filters, on every new EntityManager.
items.translation: 这可用于为每个新的 EntityManager 设置特定于供应商的参数，例如 Hibernate 过滤器。

items.source: Return the vendor-specific JpaDialect implementation for this provider, or null if there is none.
items.translation: 返回此提供者的特定于厂商的 JpaDialect 实现，如果没有则返回 `null`。

items.source:
SPI interface that allows to plug in vendor-specific behavior
into Spring's EntityManagerFactory creators. Serves as single
configuration point for all vendor-specific properties.
items.translation: 允许将特定于供应商的行为插入到 Spring 的 EntityManagerFactory 创建器中的 SPI 接口。作为所有特定于供应商属性的单一配置点。

items.source: Return the vendor-specific persistence provider.
items.translation: 返回特定于供应商的持久性提供者。

items.source:
Return the name of the persistence provider's root package
(for example, "oracle.toplink.essentials"). Will be used for
excluding provider classes from temporary class overriding.
items.translation: 返回持久化提供程序根包名称（例如，"oracle.toplink.essentials"）。将用于从临时类覆盖中排除提供程序类。

items.source: pui - the PersistenceUnitInfo for the current persistence unit
items.translation: - 当前持久化单元的 PersistenceUnitInfo

items.source:
a Map of JPA properties, as accepted by the standard JPA bootstrap
facilities, or an empty Map if there are no properties to expose
items.translation: 一个由标准 JPA 引导设施接受的 JPA 属性 Map，或者如果没有要暴露的属性则为空 Map。

items.source:
Return the vendor-specific EntityManagerFactory interface
that the EntityManagerFactory proxy is supposed to implement.
items.translation: 返回 EntityManagerFactory 代理应该实现的特定于供应商的 EntityManagerFactory 接口。

items.source:
Return the vendor-specific EntityManager interface
that this provider's EntityManagers will implement.
items.translation: 返回此提供者中的 EntityManager 将实现的特定于供应商的 EntityManager 接口。

items.source:
Return a Map of vendor-specific JPA properties,
typically based on settings in this JpaVendorAdapter instance.
items.translation: 返回一个包含特定于供应商的 JPA 属性的 Map，通常基于此 JpaVendorAdapter 实例中的设置。

items.source:
Return a Map of vendor-specific JPA properties for the given persistence
unit, typically based on settings in this JpaVendorAdapter instance.
items.translation: 返回给定持久化单元的供应商特定 JPA 属性的 Map，通常基于此 JpaVendorAdapter 实例中的设置。

items.source:
Return the name of the persistence provider's root package
(for example, "oracle.toplink.essentials").
items.translation: 返回持久化提供程序的根包名称（例如，"oracle.toplink.essentials"）。

items.source:
Optional callback for post-processing the native EntityManager
before active use.
items.translation: 用于在主动使用之前对原生 EntityManager 进行后处理的可选回调。

items.source:
Optional callback for post-processing the native EntityManagerFactory
before active use.
items.translation: 用于在主动使用之前对原生 EntityManagerFactory 进行后处理的可选回调。
